name: 3W Clinic Collagen & Luxury Gold Revitalizing Comfort Moisture 24K Gold Cream 100ml (Korea)
description:
It can confirm 24k pure gold powder at the moment of application to the skin, and the gold ingredient normalizes the flow of skin ions and increases the absorption rate of the active ingredient. 
It contains vegetable collagen ingredients such as oats and amino acids that help maintain skin elasticity and youthfulness. 
Enriched with Pure Gold Extract (99.9%) to soothe irritated skin. / Gold 25PPM 
Revitalizing Comfort 24K Gold Cream / Anti-Wrinkle Effect. 
All Skin Type
